setup.mode: unknown: the reference picture of the filmed item is left out of the gallery (locate() excludeWikidata), as DATUM_HOLDOUT=1
setup.frames: 12 frames per video, whole frame plus square crops, as the engine's quick stage samples them
setup.worldModelCandidate: GeoCLIP's best point (LocateDiagnostics.worldModel.best) of every answer with method 'worldmodel'
setup.landmarkCandidate: the answer of method 'landmark' with tier strong or recognised (the engine searches strong only, streetlevel.ts STREETLEVEL_RULE)
setup.mapillary: not measured: no Mapillary key on the measuring machine
setup.wrongPin: a match whose refined point lies farther from the truth than its stated radius (at least 1 km)
setup.rule: chosen on the train half (even index): the lowest concentration threshold from 0.2 with at least 10 matches and at most one wrong pin per ten of them; none: the world-model path stays off
setup.split: videos sorted by id; even index = train, odd = test, as scripts/datum/evaluate.ts

looserCriterion.note: the first run of this script required one train match instead of ten; changed because a single match cannot show a wrong-pin rate of one in ten

landmark.note: in unknown mode a recognised landmark is a look-alike of the filmed one; this is the false-match risk of the engine rule
